_note: A fixture, not a capture. Nothing here came out of an AI product, and it is not part of the frozen
query set in queries/. It exists so the Phase 0 and Phase 2 path can be run end to end before the
extension exists. The URLs are chosen to exercise different G2 outcomes against the live web:
one readable page, one guaranteed 404, and one path that robots.txt disallows.
answer_text: Adjuvant therapy is given after primary treatment to lower the risk of recurrence [1]. A page that does not exist returns a 404 rather than an absence of evidence [2]. Some paths are disallowed by robots.txt, which is a decision not to look rather than a failure to reach [3].
